Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, 
Advocate, for the appellant.
Mr. Arvind Vashistha, Senior 
Advocate, for the respondent.
(2) Vide order dated 28.8.2012, 
coordinate Bench of this Court passed an 
interim order to the following effect:
“Considering the facts of the 
case it is directed that if the appellant 
deposits a sum of Rs. 15 lacs with this 
court within a period of eight weeks from 
today, the execution of the impugned 
judgment and decree shall remain 
stayed. It is also directed that the 
appellant shall not create any third party 
interest in the property in question.”
(3) Today, the matter is listed on 
an application seeking extension of the 
aforesaid interim order. For the reasons 
indicated in the said application, interim 
order dated 28.8.2012 is extended only 
till the next date of listing, which is fixed 
for 13.10.2023. Stay extension 
application (IA/9252/2023) stands 
disposed of accordingly. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 28.8.2023 Pr
